integrity: Analytic proof with a supplementary reproducible numerical script. No independent audit or validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the Euclidean planar quartic unit ball at fixed finite angular crossover parameter, locally uniformly in that parameter; no claim for arbitrary norm balls, higher dimensions, or joint unbounded-parameter scaling. Previously unindexed equivalent literature remains possible. Numerical tests do not establish an infinite theorem.
title: Cubic-angle boundary layer for the quartic-ball covariogram
